_comment: Per-device preset overrides for lamp. See robots/contract/ROBOT-SPEC.md § Per-device presets. Lamp's LED ring has 64 pixels (vs the platform default of 64). Emotion colors below regroup the base palette into 6 hues 60 deg apart — see robots/lamp/docs/emotion-led-mapping.md § Six hue groups for why.
_comment_scene: Scene brightness only — hue (the color temperature mix) stays at the base value. Two things were wrong at the base levels. (1) reading/focus/energize all landed above lamp's max_brightness ceiling of 120, and clamp_color only scales DOWN, so all three collapsed to peak 120: three different scenes rendering as one, at the brightest level the ring can do. (2) Peak alone understates a scene: unlike an emotion cue, a scene lights all 64 pixels, so total flux is far higher than the peak number suggests — judging a scene by its peak the way we judge an indicator makes it come out too bright, which is what happened on the first pass here. Peaks now: energize 61, reading 48, focus 38, relax 25, movie 10, night 3. Night is deliberately far below the rest — it is a nightlight, meant to let you find your way without waking you, not to light the room; it is also blue-free by hue so it does not suppress melatonin. Spaced wider at the top because perceived brightness goes as roughly the cube root of value.
